rationale: Sparse customer table with email/phone (clearly PII) but ZERO classification, ZERO masking. correctness=3 (acceptable): types are reasonable. completeness=2: contract present but no SLA, no retention, no owner. security=0 (missing): PII columns (email, phone) unmasked, untagged — this is the canonical security-failure case where 'missing' is the honest score. governance=1 (severely deficient): no owner, no retention, no access policies — 'a contract exists' floor. performance=1: no partition/clustering for what would be a dimension table. documentation=1: no descriptions; product has a name.
